ἐφίστημι.mg: to set over; mid., pass., 2 ao. and the perfects, stand upon, 137
ἐφίστημι.s: ἐφίστημι : in intr. tenses and passive, I come upon (suddenly or unexpectedly) and stand by: met, I press Sorward, 2 Tim. iv 2.

λατρεύω.s: λατρεύω, I serve, especially God, perhaps simply I worship.

μνημονεύω.s: μνημονεύώ, I remember; I hold in remembrance ; I make mention of, Heb. xi 22.

παράπτωμα.s: παράπτωμα (delictum), a falling away, a lapse, a slip, a false step, a trespass.

τελώνης.s: τελώνης, collector (recetver) of customs, lax-galherer, revenue official, of any rank, but especially of Jews of the lower rank, who collected revenue for the Roman overlord, detested by their fellow-countrymen and practically identified with ἁμαρτωλοί,

τεσσαράκοντα.s: τεσσαράκοντα (the spelling τεσσεράκοντα is late and illiterate), forty.

τιμάω.s: τιμάῳ, I honour, give honour to.

ὑπακούω.s: ὑπακούω, 7 οὖεν : c. infin, Heb. xi 8.

χιλιάς.s: χιλιάς, a thousand, looked upon as a unit,

ἀκροβυστία.s: ἀκροβυστία (a technical word of Jewish use, adapted from éxpomoabia[?]), foreskin, prepuce: used sometimes as a slang term by Jews, of Gentiles (Eph. ii 11).

βάπτισμα.s: βάπτισμα, a dipping, a baptism : c. gen. μετανοίας, belonging to a change of mental attitude, sign of a change of mental attitude.

ἐνεργέω.s: ἐνεργέω, (a) intr. I am αἱ work, work; (Ὁ) tr. I work, the acc. expressing ‘that which is worked’, effect, In N.T. the word is generally connected with miraculous interpositions ; (0) in the passive always with non-personal subject, as ἐνεργεῖν always with personal, I am made operative (effective), I am made to produce my appropriate result, I am sel in operation, I am made to work. Mid. absent from N.T.

ἐπίγνωσις.s: ἐπίγνωσις, knowledge of a particular point (directed towards a particular object); perception, discernment, recognition ; intuition.

μαρτύριον.s: μαρτύριον, witness, evidence (of recovery, Mt. viii 4, Mk. i 44, Lk.v 14: so of other occurrences or thoughts): ἡ σκηνὴ τοῦ papruplov, the lent of the congregation, Ze Tent of meeting of God with His people, because it contained the ark and the tablets of The testimony to the covenant between God and his people, cf. Exod. xxv 9, 10.

ξύλον.s: ξύλον, wood, a piece of wood; hence, a club, a staff, Mk. xiv 43, 48 and parallels ; The trunk of a ree, used to support the cross-bar of a cross in crucifixion, Ac.v 30, ἄς. ; a tree, Lk. xxiii 31, ζωῆς, the fruit of which gives life, Rev. ii 7, xxii 2, 14, 10.

προάγω.s: wpodye, (a) tr. σοφός.d: cf. sophomore, literally, a wise fool [μωρός]
σοφός.s: σοφός, wise: (Flebraism) skilled, an experi, a man of learning, Mt. xi 2g, 1 Cor. iii 10, &c.

ὑψόω.d: cf. hypsophobia, fear of high places
ὑψόω.s: ὑψόω, I raise to a height, I lift up, I exall, usually met,

γεωργός.s: γεωργός, a worker of the soil, husbandman, farmer, farmlabourer.

διακρίνω.s: διακρίνω, I separate, distinguish, discern onc thing from: another ; διακρίνομαι, I doubt, hesitate, waver.

δῶρον.d: Theodore, Dorothea [or Dorothy], gift of God

ἐπάνω.s: ἐπάνω, (2) adv. on the lop, above; (Ὁ) prep. on the lop of, above, over, on: met. of rule, over, Lk. xix 17, &c.; above, more than, Mk. xiv g, 1 Cor. xv 6.

I strike upon, Mk. iv 37; (€) intr. τὸ ἐπιβάλλον μέρος, the share that falls to (belongs lo) one, Lk. xv 123 (fy intr, ἐπιβαλὼν ἔκλαιεν, he sel lo and wept, MK. xiv 72.

ἐπιλαμβάνομαι.s: ἐπιλαμβάνομαι, I lay hold of; take hold of, seize (sometimes with beneficent, sometimes with hostile, intent).

ἐπουράνιος.s: ἐπουράνιος (Opp. émiyews), heavenly, in heaven: ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις, τ the heavenly sphere, the sphere of spiritual activities.

ἡγεμών.d: cf. hegemony, leadership, especially of one state of a confederacy
ἡγεμών.s: ἡγεμών (praeses, a very wide word), « (Roman) governor.

κοινωνία.s: κοινωνία, (lit. partnership) (a) contributory help, Ac. ii 42, Rom. xv 26, 2 Cor. vill 4, ix 13, Heb. xiii 16; (0) sharing ἐπ, Phil. i 5, iii 10, Philem. 6, cf. κτίσις.s: κτίσις (often of the founding of a city), (a) abstr, creation; (Ὁ) concr., creation, creature, institution. Always of Divine work.

μεριμνάω.s: μεριμνάω, I am over-anxious; c. acc. I am anxious about, I care for.

μέχρι or μέχρις.g: until; with the gen., as far as

παλαιός.s: παλαιός, old; ὁ παλαιὸς ἄνθρωπος (perhaps Hebraism), one’s former character (personality). The word and its derivatives bear a derogatory sense. :

παρατίθημι.g: I set before; middle, I entrust
παρατίθημι.mg: to set before or beside, provide
παρατίθημι.s: παρατίθημι, (a) (adpono) I sef (especially a meal) before, 4 serve; (Ὁ) (depono) act, and mid., I deposit with, I entrust το.

προφητεία.s: προφητεία, the quality or action of a προφήτης, declaration of the will of God, whether with special reference to the future, in which case it may be translated prophecy, or not.

τέλειος.s: τέλειος (from τέλος, ‘final end’), (a) full-grown, mature, complete, having reached its utmost development, c.g. Eph.iv 13, Heb.vig; (b) completely good (simply), Jamesi 4; completely operative, Jamesiny; perfect, as dealing with universal principles, Jamesizs; perfect in character, Mt. v 48, Jamesiii 2, &c.

τοσοῦτος.g: so great, so much; plural, so many
τοσοῦτος.mg: so great, so much, so many
τοσοῦτος.s: τοσοῦτος (tantus), so great, so large; of time, so long, plur. (tot, later tanti) so may: τοσούτου, αἱ such and such a price, Ac.v 8.

τρέχω.s: τρέχω, I run; sometimes ον. acc. of the course, Heb. xii1: also met. e.g. Gal.ii 2.

ἀληθῶς.mg: truly, really, actually. ὡς ἀληθῶς same as ἀληθῶς

ἀνάγκη.s: ἀνάγκη, necessity, consiraini, compulsion; ἔχω ἀνάγκην, I am obliged.

δέησις.s: δέησις, a requesting, a begging, request.

δεσμός.s: δεσμός, plur. sometimes δεσμά, a loud, chain; in Ac. xxiii 29, xxvi 31 (= uincula), the reference is to the form of ‘capital’ punishment involving loss of freedom and work in chains in the quarries.

ἐλέγχω.s: ἐλέγχω, (a) I reprove, rebuke: (Ὁ) I expose, show to be guilty, Johniii zo, 1 Cor. xiv 24, Eph.v 11,13, James

θυμός.s: Qupds, an outburst of passion, wrath.

κατέχω.mg: to hold, check, seize, occupy, cease

κενός.d: cenotaph, sepulchral monument to a person whose body is elsewhere
κενός.s: κενός, (a) empty ; (b) met. empty (in moral content), vas, ineffective, foolish, worthless; εἰς κενόν, in vain, to no purpose; (0) false, unreal, pretentious, hollow, Eph. v6, Col. ii 8, Jamesii zo.

κληρονομέω.s: κληρονομέω, I inherit, I obtain (possess) by inheritance.

κοιμάομαι.s: κοιμάομαι, I fall asleep, I am asleep, sometimes of the sleep of death (e. g. Mt. xxvii 52).

κόπος.s: κόπος, (a) trouble; κύπους (κύπον) τινι παρέχειν, to give trouble Jo one, to annoy one; (Ὁ) todl, labour, laborious foal, involving weariness and fatigue.

κρυπτός.s: κρυπτός, hidden, secret: τὰ κρυπτά, as subst. fhe hidden (secret) things (parls), the inward nature (character); ἐν [τῷ] κρυπτῷ, in the secret place, tn the hidden sphere, inwardly.

μήν.d: menology, a calendar, especially that of the Greek Church, provided with short biographies of saints
μήν.mg: affirm. part., but, truly, indeed, forsooth, certainly
μήν.s: μήν, adverb, expressing emphasis, mostly in the formulae of oaths, assuredly, tn very truth.

μήτι.g: interrogative particle, expecting a negative answer
μήτι.s: μήτι (μή strengthened by the addition of the acc. neut. of τις (indefinite) as adv.), (a) with ef: thus εἰ μήτι = εἰ μή, 17 not, unless, Tk.ix 13, εἰ μήτι ἄν, uniess in a given case, 1 Cor. vii 5; (Ὁ) in questions, expecting a negative answer, cf. Mt, vii 16, can 12 be that ? suggesting impossibility.

οἰκοδομή.s: οἰκοδομή, (a) abstract, building, the operation (process) of building, sometimes transitional, without being strictly concrete, 1 Cor. iii 9, 2 Cor. v 1, Eph.iizr, ἵν τς, τό, 29 (here perhaps = improvement) ; met, pbuilding, edification; (b) concrete, a building, Mk. xiii 1, 2, Mt. xxiv 1.

προστίθημι.s: προστίθημι (addo), I place (put) to, I add : mid. c. infin. (perhaps a Hebraistic idiom), best translated by representing the verb in the infinitive by the indicative, and adding the word besides, &c., thus :—wpoaἔθετο πέμψαι, besides (in addition, further) he sent, Lk, xx τι.

στέφανος.s: στέφανος, a garland, wreath, chaplet, crown, generally as the Greek victor’s crown or chaplet, of perishable leaves (x Cor. ix 25), won in athletic and other contests, and familiar to the Jews for generations: ὁ στέφανος τῆς ζωῆς (James i 12, δεν, ἢ 10), the crown (reward), which is life.

τίκτω.s: τίκτω (of a woman), I bear, give birth to, bring forth: hence met., of the earth, Heb. νἱ 7, of evil desire,

ὑποκριτής.s: ὑποκριτής (properly an actor), a hypocrite, one who outwardly plays the part of a religious man to perfection, but is inwardly alien to the spirit of true religion.

ὑπομένω.s: ὑπομένω, (4) I remain behind, Lk.ii43, Ac.xviirg; (0) absolutely, I stand my ground, I show endurance, Mt. x 22, &c.; with τῇ θλίψει, Rom. xii 12, 12 persecuton, amid persecution, with εἰς = ἐν, eb. xii 7 ; (0) tr. endure, bear up against.

ἀρέσκω.s: ἀρέσκω, I please, with the idea of willing service rendered to others ; hence almost .7 serve.

αὐτοῦ.s: ἑαυτοῦ, &c., self, selves; for all three persons, singular (not first person) and plural, according to context, ourselves ; yourself, yourselves ; himself; herself, itself, themselves.

ἄφεσις.s: ἄφεσις (from ἀφίημι) (remissio), ὦ sending away, ἃ [οί

δέσμιος.s: δέσμιας, bound, captive, in chains ; sometimes substantivally prasoner, captive.

εἰσπορεύομαι.s: εἰσπορεύομαι, I journey im(1o), I go in(io).

ἑκατόν.d: hecatomb, great public sacrifice, properly of 100 oxen [βοῦς]
ἑκατόν.s: ἑκατόν, a hundred; εἰς ἑκατόν, see εἷς,

ἐπιμένω.s: ἐπιμένω, (a) I remain, tarry (0) c. dat. I remain in, persist in.

θησαυρός.s: θησαυρός, a slore-house for precious things; hence a treasure, a store.

καθάπερ.s: καθάπερ (i. 6. kal ἅπερ, according lo which things), even

κερδαίνω.s: κερδαίνω, I gain; ὕβριν καὶ ζημίαν, I gain injury and loss, Le. I gain by shunning injury and loss, I do not suffer (I am spared) injury and loss, Ac. xxvii z1.

νίπτω.s: νίπτω, I wash; mid. I wash my own (hands, &c.).

νυμφίος.s: νυμφίος, a bridegroom : name applied to the Messiah, Mk. ii 19, 20 and parallels.

περιτέμνω.s: περιτέμνω (circumeido), I caf round the foreskin, I circumeise.

πέτρα.s: πέτρα, rock, solid rock, native rock, rising up through the earth, which trips up the traveller, Rom. ix 33, 1 Pet. ii 8; in Mt xvi 18, of such faith as Peter has just shown; in 1 Cor. x 4, allegorically interpreted.

πλήρωμα.d: pleroma, in Valentinian Gnosticism, the world of light, including the body of eons
πλήρωμα.s: πλήρωμα (indicates the result of the activity denoted by πληρύω), (a) a fill, fullness ; full complement; supply, supplement, Mk. it 21, Mt. ix 16; (0) fullness, filling, Julfilment, completion.

πλησίον.g: near; as a noun, a neighbor
πλησίον.s: πλησίον, adv. (near, Johniv 5), used as adj. and (especially with article ὁ) noun, neighbouring, neighbourly ; a netghbour.

ποιμήν.s: ποιμήν, a shepherd : hence met. of the feeder, protector, and ruler of a flock of men.

σκοτία.d: scotoscope, a fieldglass for seeing by night
σκοτία.s: σκοτία, darkness © hence met. of ignorance and sin.

χάρισμα.d: charism, a special spiritual gift or power divinely conferred; I Cor. 12
χάρισμα.s: χάρισμα, a free (gracious) gift, a gift, an endowment, especially from God.

ὡσαύτως.s: ὡσαύτως, ἐπ the same way, Fkewise.

ἀνακρίνω.mg: to examine well; mid. question one with another
ἀνακρίνω.s: ἀνακρίνω, I examine, inquire info (judicially: see ἀνάxpos); of the preliminary examination, preceding the trial proper : hence with derived applications.

ἀπάγω.s: ἀπάγω, I lead away, [for example (=duco) I lad away to execution, Ac. xii 19]; hence, in the moral sphere, 1 Cor.xiiz; also, of a road lading to a place.

δεῖπνον.s: δεῖπνον, a dinner, an afternoon Or evening meal.

δηνάριον.s: δηνάριον, a denarius, a small Roman silver coin, weighing in Nero's time 53 grs. Its value and purchasing power varied from time to time,

ἐντέλλομαι.s: ἐντέλλομαι, I give orders (injunctions, instructions, commands),

ἐργάτης.s: ἐργάτης, a field-labourer; then, a labourer, workman in general,

ζῆλος.s: tiles (masc, and neut.), (2) eagerness, zeal, enthusiasm ; (b) jealousy, rivalry.

θεμέλιος.s: θεμέλιος (properly an adj. belonging fo the foundation, with λίθος understood), a foundation stone; pur. neut. fepédia is used, Ac. xvi 26.

κακῶς.s: κακῶς, dedly, evilly © κακῶς ἔχω, sec ἔχω.

πολεμός.s: πόλεμος, a war; also, a battle, Lk. xiv 31, &c.

προσδοκάω.s: προσδοκάω, I expect, wail jor, await.

ῥαββεί or ῥαββί.s: ραββεί (Aramaic), my master, a title given by pupils to their teacher.

ῥίζα.s: pita, a roof: hence met., a source.

συκῆ.d: sycophant, a flatterer, literally, a fig-shower [the reason for the name is not definitely known]

συλλαμβάνω.s: συλλαμβάνω (συνλ-), (a) (conprehendo) act. and mid. I arrest, catch, capture: (Ὁ) I conceive (a child), cf. met. James ig; (0) mid. I lend a hand to, I help, Lk.v 7%, Phil. iva.

συνίστημι or συνιστάνω.g: transitive tenses, I commend; intransitive tenses, I stand with, consist

τέρας.s: τέρας, a prodigy, an extraordinary occurrence (appearance, act), a startling porient.

τολμάω.s: τολμάω, I have courage, I dare, I have the hardihood ; I take courage, Mk. xv 43; I submit to, Rom. v 7.

τροφή.d: cf. atrophy, wasting due to malnutrition

I come late, I am late, Heb. iv 1; Lam left behind in the race for, I have no par! in, with ἀπό and the gen. of the end, Heb. xii 15; I fall short, I am inferior, Mt. xix 20, 1 Cor, xii 24 (v.1), 2 Cor. xi 5, xii 11 ; I am wanting (to), Mk. x 21 (v.1.), Johnii 3; Lam without, c. gen.
